environment: Flutter stable 3.44.0; Redmi 22041211AC on Android 14 connected by authorized USB debugging; Redmi WLAN 192.168.31.208/24 and Mac WLAN 192.168.31.241/24

implementation.mobile_authority: The Flutter client pairs through the vNext mobile API, stores only the bearer token and selected Run ID in platform secure storage, reads the server-projected RunSnapshot and submits only a current choice ID plus expected revision to /api/v2/mobile/runs/{id}/choices. It has no model, World, Lorebook, archive, purge or arbitrary command UI.
implementation.gameplay_ui: The app presents pairing/re-pairing, manual Host and Run entry, chapter/route/relationship reasons/ending/turn history, current choices, conflict hydration guidance and revoked-token recovery guidance.
implementation.network: Android deliberately allows cleartext HTTP for the user-selected local Mac Host because vNext LAN Host is authenticated HTTP today. The app documents that untrusted endpoints are out of scope.

verification.static: dart format, flutter analyze and three Flutter tests passed. The mobile API test asserts that gameplay calls the mobile /choices endpoint with bearer token and expected revision, and preserves a 409 conflict.
verification.physical_device: ADB recognizes the Redmi as an authorized device. The first adb install was stopped by the phone with INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED, so the APK is not yet installed and no pairing/LAN/recovery claim is made.

boundary: This is a source/build readiness milestone only. It does not satisfy Android recovery scoring until the phone permits USB installation and the complete Mac approval, pairing, choice, conflict, revocation, Wi-Fi/Mac-restart and recovery matrix has passed.
